parts.label: Right-hand side of dM/dx
parts.help: Use V for the signed shear V(x) in the source convention.

parts.label: Second derivative d²M/dx²
parts.help: Uniform beam and stated shear convention; all dimensional parameters positive.

parts.label: Shear V(x)
parts.help: Simply supported beam; 0 ≤ x ≤ L, positive dimensions, density and g.

parts.label: Bending moment M(x)
parts.help: Simply supported beam; M(0) = M(L) = 0 and 0 ≤ x ≤ L.

parts.label: Normal stress fxx(y)
parts.help: Use R for the signed radius R(x), R ≠ 0. Source convention Y = −fxx/(Δl/l).

parts.label: Bending moment from curvature
parts.help: R is the signed curvature radius R(x), R ≠ 0; rectangular section.

parts.label: Positive midpoint drop
parts.help: Small slopes, simple supports, self-weight only. Enter a positive drop, not the negative upward displacement.

parts.label: Wave-equation order n
parts.help: Enter the result in the displayed unit, without a unit suffix.

parts.label: Wave-equation coefficient A
parts.help: Rayleigh beam model including rotational inertia; positive physical parameters.

parts.label: Wave-equation coefficient B
parts.help: Rotational inertia term on the right-hand side has positive coefficient.

parts.label: Thin-beam phase velocity
parts.help: Neglect rotational inertia; all parameters positive; ω is angular frequency, not ordinary frequency.

parts.label: Thin-beam group velocity
parts.help: Same thin-beam limit; group velocity is twice phase velocity.
